notes: Midships is mainly an identity services firm (Ping Identity, Keycloak). Icebreaker is patent pending and the site says it is in active customer pilot and not yet in production at a tier 1 bank, so every Icebreaker sub is capped at partial. Icebreaker is an action authorization layer. It decides allow, approval required or deny per proposed agent action and does not inspect prompts, scan models or run attacks. Modules 3 and 4 are low-confidence partials because the product is a pre-action decision point and not a detector or prompt guardrail.
